authority.mask: First-Walk applied authority remains 14s; original 2s mask remains at all other nodes
authority.observation: Original61 features and original2s active flag retained; deterministic probe ignores observation/reward
authority.probe_subset: yaw-only (0,0,-1), first Walk only; zero elsewhere
authority.scope_limit: Later residual actions cannot repair the first Walk strict failure; finite first-window profiles do not cover all continuous admissible action sequences
authority.velocity_basis: body command inputs to frozen locomotion controller

controls: Read-only historical residual-off, 14 s lateral-only and 14 s combined; inherited combined2/zero14/repeat gates remain PASS
Exact pre-Stand and first-Walk start/reference anchor gate for each new run
Local adapter/source hash and offline action schedule checks before physics
evidence: all raw result rows including failures
20Hz state archives and exact final pose (acquisition samples, no media)

additional_requirements: final absolute commanded-axis lateral not worse
final absolute wrapped commanded-heading error not worse
global_claim.metric: final commanded-world Euclidean endpoint error strictly lower than its alpha0.5 residual-off baseline
global_claim.not_claimed: all-prefix or all-component Pareto improvement; no new historical global success threshold
required_disclosure: full final XY vector including any X regression
per-node world vector/norm/head, including prefix tradeoff

interpretation: Within-case deterministic fixed14s 2x2 component contrast. Raw outcome interaction I = q_combined - q_lateral - q_yaw + q_off for first-Walk local lateral, final world X/Y, and wrapped final commanded-heading error. Norm is nonlinear derived metric; report it without actuator-additivity inference. Reference-feedback dynamics can couple components. No invented interaction-significance threshold, generalization, baseline adoption or full-space infeasibility.
local_claim: STRICT endpoint eligibility on all original nodes; nominal independent secondary report; not continuous/environmental corridor safety
origin: actual node start; frozen selector unchanged
physical_claim: original complete physical success, finite/valid execution and all original nodes SUCCESS; report status/fall/tilt/height separately

preregistration.rationale: Complete the missing actuator component control at frozen 14 s. Compare yaw-only against retained off, lateral-only, and combined without selecting another profile.
preregistration.conditional_confirmation: Run one exact repeat only if primary passes all-node strict, complete physical success and frozen paired global condition; otherwise stop after primary and retain negative result.

preserved: original observation and dense_reward callback path; reward ignored, never tuned
node boundaries/targets/skill lifecycle and all envelopes
Legacy2s transition diagnostic monitor and observation active feature; applied firstWalk authority mask remains fixed at14s

process_limits.progress: flushed10Hz trace and decision ledger plus per-run completed message

question: At fixed 14 s authority and unchanged alpha0.5 reference, does yaw-only (0,0,-1) satisfy first-Walk strict, physical, and same-reference global conditions? What are the descriptive component and interaction effects across retained off/lateral-only/combined and new yaw-only?
reference_choice: fixed retained challenge, not alpha optimization
roundoff_role: arithmetic verification only, not a task threshold; paired gains within this resolution cannot establish FEASIBLE
schedule_and_stop: Run yaw14 primary; if joint gate fails, stop without confirmation; if it qualifies, run one deterministic repeat. Integrity/incomplete failure stops preserving partial. No alternate action, amplitude or duration.
stopping_boundary: After primary, optional exact witness confirmation, targeted audit/report and Git closeout. No PPO, reward alignment, Jev, Multi-Swarm, or window search.

verdict_rules.FEASIBLE: Only repeated exact yaw14 witness satisfying frozen strict, complete physical and paired-global conditions.
verdict_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: No repeated joint witness and no full-space certificate; retain probed failures and measured window/authority effects without training expansion.
verdict_rules.NOT_FEASIBLE: Only with a validated reachability/invariant bound covering the entire admissible continuous authority or mutually incompatible required hard goals; saturation/failed probes/command integrals are not such proof.

component_comparison.norm: report endpoint norm per cell, no norm-additivity claim
component_comparison.interpretation: descriptive deterministic finite difference only, not strict causal additivity
